title: Bound pre-auth federation header and idle connection lifetimes
outcome: Unauthenticated partial headers and idle keepalive connections cannot indefinitely occupy all four dedicated federation socket slots.
acceptance: A stalled pre-auth connection returns its slot within a bounded header/idle deadline without requiring host shutdown; legitimate authenticated requests retain existing request bounds.
Regression tests cover four stalled pre-auth sockets, subsequent authenticated service, and shutdown; required gate and review evidence accompany the fix.
